content.what_it_is: Commented/teaching variant of the beach_2d plot_wave.m MATLAB script with a 'User Input' section (L4-L22): fdir='../input_files/output/' @L9; nfile=[10,50] @L12; time labels times={'20','100'} @L15 (comment says minutes @L14, title prints 'sec' @L73); plot_color_bars=true toggle @L18; length-mismatch error check (L24-L26). Grid from eta_00001 (L29-L36, dx=dy=2.0), sponge outline (L39-L40), wavemaker outline (L43-L44), 8x5-inch figure (L47-L49). Per snapshot: loads eta_/mask_ (L60-L61), NaN-masks @L64, subplot @L67, pcolor with caxis([-0.5 2]) (L70-L72), title @L73, sponge (green dashed @L79) and wavemaker (red @L83) outlines with rotated white labels, ylabel on first panel (L90-L92), xlabel @L94, colorbar labelled '\eta (m)' when toggled (L97-L100), zbuffer renderer @L102; print commented @L105.
entities: script; clear all @L2; variables: fdir @L9; nfile @L12; times @L15; plot_color_bars @L18; eta @L29/@L60; n,m @L30; dx @L33; dy @L34; x @L35; y @L36; x_sponge @L39; y_sponge @L40; x_wavemaker @L43; y_wavemaker @L44; wid @L47; len @L48; num @L53; fnum @L57; mask @L61; h1 @L80; h2 @L84; cbar @L98
calls: error(...) @L25; builtins: load, size, sprintf, set/gcf/clf, subplot, pcolor/shading/caxis, title, plot, text, xlabel/ylabel, colorbar
unresolved: Comment @L14 calls the times values 'minutes' while the title @L73 prints 'sec' — with a 2 s output interval the values 20/100 are seconds; commented print name @L105 is the inlet_shoal template leftover; zbuffer renderer @L102 removed in newer MATLAB
